commands: F=/etc/amazon/ssm/amazon-ssm-agent.json; if [ ! -f "$F" ]; then for t in /snap/amazon-ssm-agent/current/amazon-ssm-agent.json.template /etc/amazon/ssm/amazon-ssm-agent.json.template; do [ -f "$t" ] && cp "$t" "$F" && break; done; fi; [ -f "$F" ] || { echo 'NO agent config and no template found (checked the snap and /etc/amazon/ssm templates), stop here'; exit 1; }
grep -n SessionLogsDestination /etc/amazon/ssm/amazon-ssm-agent.json || { echo 'config has no SessionLogsDestination key: agent older than 3.2.2086, stop here'; exit 1; }
(sleep 2; snap restart amazon-ssm-agent 2>/dev/null || systemctl restart amazon-ssm-agent) >/dev/null 2>&1 &
